summary: Large One Bedroom Flat · Prime Jesmond · Available Summer 2024 · Single Occ. or Couple
description:
My Property Box welcome to the market this newly refurbished groundfloor flat on Grosvenor Road, Jesmond. Ideally situated close to Osborne Road, the large flat offers a spacious living room and kitchen, central modern bathroom with walk-in shower, generous bedroom with purpose built walk-in wardrobe room. Benefitting from a south facing rear yard accessible from French doors in the living room, the light and airy flat is perfect for a single occupant or couple who desire central Jesmond living away from the noisy student streets.

To arrange a viewing, contact MPB today and speak to the Lettings Team.
